source: Parameters from MAS published guidance (TDSR 55%, medium-term rate floor 4%, LTV 75% for a first loan with tenure <=30 years). The Notice 645 PDF was unreachable when this was written, so the parameters are MAS explainer-sourced rather than read off the Notice; re-verify before shipping. The arithmetic below was recomputed independently in Python with exact Decimal maths and agrees to the dollar. NOTE: the 75% LTV also requires the tenure to end before age 65, and this tool does not ask for age, so it does not apply that check.

cases.note: 9,000 income, 600 debts, HDB: MSR binds at 2,700 not TDSR at 4,350
12,000 income, 1,000 debts, private: TDSR binds at 5,600
